text:
ravi: quick poll  sunday plans: sunset paddle on the bay (5:15pm) vs open-mic night at The Finch (8pm)? kayak or karaoke? :kayak: :microphone: 

zoe: Paddle! nothing beats golden hour on the water. ill bring a headlamp and a thermos. :sunset:

nora: Open-mic for me. practicing an acoustic cover and need an audience. :guitar:

diego: Can we do sunset paddle then dash to open-mic? timing tight but doable if paddle is short.

ravi: plan would be 90min paddle, meet at 5:10 at marina dock. Finch doors at 7:30 so it's a squeeze. anyone up for both? :eyes:

zoe: Im up for both if someone can give me a lift from the marina to downtown. public transit is meh after dusk.

nora: I can drive! 3 seats. leaving Finch by 7:10 would be perfect.

diego: Heads-up: bring life jackets and a dry bag. last time my phone went swimming. learned the hard way. :sob:

calendar-bot: Event created: "Sunset Paddle" Sun 5:15 PM  RSVP: https://calendar.company/events/55521

ravi: RSVP'd for paddle. if open-mic lineup fills up we can always do a late-night KM session at the lounge. :wink:

zoe: GIF: https://giphy.com/sunset-paddle-hype.gif :grin:

nora: RSVP for open-mic too. will bring picks + a small amp if needed.

diego: Vote tally: paddle 2, open-mic 1, both 2. looks like a hybrid weekend. see y'all sunday! :party_parrot:
